headline: Gutter Flips at Suojus; Linn Mercy Remains Costliest Ground
war_summary: The ledger at Gutter has shifted since the last edition: Suojus changed hands early this morning, leaving one Colonial work among six Warden, and the fighting there is the sharpest of the hour at better than fifty Warden and forty Colonial casualties. Linn Mercy remains the costliest ground, with ten Colonial works, none Warden and one unclaimed; fourteen events fell in the day, chiefly about Outwich Ranch, though the volume of dead has cooled from the hour before. Palantine Berm tallied four events in two hours and twenty-six in the day, holding five Colonial works to two Warden. Weathered Expanse, scene of thirty-four events in the day across seven Warden works and two unclaimed, has gone quiet in the latest six hours. Mooring County, wholly Warden, counted twenty-seven events and nine Warden captures in the day, while Marban Hollow logged twenty about Checkpoint Bua and Nevish Line six near Grief Mother. Clahstra and Stlican Shelf report casualty rates climbing. Thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
